name: Flaming Weapon
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level: magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

Components: V, S, M (a small piece of steel and coal)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Touch

Target(s): Weapon touched

Duration: 1 minute/level

Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance: yes (harmless, object)

This spell temporarily transforms an existing melee weapon into a flaming weapon.

This spell cannot be cast on a natural weapon, such as an unarmed strike or bite.
